background_image_description: Full-canvas photocomposite on a misty white-to-light-gray backdrop (#f7f7f7 to #e6e6e6) with soft cloud-like smudges at the corners. Foreground subject: a stylish man in a gray overcoat and black leather glove, wearing tortoiseshell sunglasses, turned three-quarters left. His silhouette contains a double-exposure of a modern city at sunset: a glowing orange-yellow light source around the chest area (#f5a33b to #ffd266), a skyline with a very tall central tower and darker building silhouettes (#1c1c1c to #3a3a3a), and a road leading toward the city. The right side of the figure and city dissolves into hundreds of flying debris shards and particles ranging from orange (#f7a047) to brown (#7a4a2e) to dark gray/black (#121212), thinning toward the right edge. Bottom area shows darker city blocks and streets fading into shadow.

nodes.text: LARS PEETERS | DREW FEIG | SAMIRA HADID
